While these platforms vary in their authentication protocols (ranging from Google OAuth to custom token injection), they share a unified frontend architecture based on the useProviderAccountsPage hook and the createProviderAccountStore factory. Unified Frontend Architecture Cockpit Tools uses a standardized pattern for all account management pages to ensure consistent UI behavior (searching, sorting, tagging, and batch actions) across different AI platforms. The useProviderAccountsPage Hook This hook centralizes the state logic for account pages, including: View State : Grid/List toggling and search queries src/hooks/useProviderAccountsPage.ts 177-185 Selection : Multi-select logic for batch deletions or exports src/hooks/useProviderAccountsPage.ts 124-132 OAuth Lifecycle : Managing polling, timeouts, and user code display src/hooks/useProviderAccountsPage.ts 146-150 Tagging : Grouping accounts and filtering by custom tags src/hooks/useProviderAccountsPage.ts 129-132 CreateProviderAccountStore Factory A factory function used to generate Zustand stores for each platform, providing standard actions like fetchAccounts , deleteAccounts , and updateAccountTags . Platform Store Hook Page Component Cursor useCursorAccountStore CursorAccountsPage Gemini useGeminiAccountStore GeminiAccountsPage CodeBuddy useCodebuddyAccountStore CodebuddyAccountsPage CodeBuddy CN useCodebuddyCnAccountStore CodebuddyCnAccountsPage Qoder useQoderAccountStore QoderAccountsPage Trae useTraeAccountStore TraeAccountsPage Zed useZedAccountStore ZedAccountsPage Workbuddy useWorkbuddyAccountStore WorkbuddyAccountsPage Sources: src/pages/CodebuddyAccountsPage.tsx 86-121 src/pages/TraeAccountsPage.tsx 131-166 src/hooks/useProviderAccountsPage.ts 123-169 Cursor Account Management Cursor accounts are managed via CursorAccountsPage . The platform supports OAuth login, direct token import, and local import from Cursor's native storage. Implementation Details Storage : Accounts are persisted in cursor_accounts/ with a cursor_accounts.json index src-tauri/src/modules/cursor_account.rs 13-14 OAuth : Uses a device flow where the backend provides a verificationUri . The frontend polls for completion via cursorService.completeCursorOAuthLogin src-tauri/src/modules/cursor_account.rs 10-11 Banned Status : Specifically checks for account bans by evaluating the status and status_reason fields for keywords like "banned", "forbidden", or "封禁" src-tauri/src/modules/cursor_account.rs 38-60 Token Refresh : Access tokens are refreshed if they are within the threshold of 5 minutes before expiry src-tauri/src/modules/cursor_account.rs 16 Sources: src-tauri/src/modules/cursor_account.rs 13-16 src-tauri/src/modules/cursor_account.rs 38-60 Gemini CLI (Google OAuth) Gemini account management focuses on managing oauth_creds.json and providing credentials for the Gemini CLI. Data Flow OAuth : Initiated via geminiService.startGeminiOAuthLogin . Credential Management : The gemini_account.rs module manages local Google credentials by reading from the default .gemini home directory. It handles token refreshing via the Google OAuth2 endpoint. Sources: src-tauri/src/modules/gemini_account.rs 16-25 CodeBuddy, CodeBuddy CN, and Workbuddy These platforms share a specialized UI view and similar backend logic, often interacting with codebuddy.cn . Shared UI Component CodebuddySuiteAccountsSharedView is a reusable component that provides a unified interface for CodeBuddy CN, Workbuddy, and Grok src/components/codebuddy-suite/CodebuddySuiteAccountsSharedView.tsx 81-85 It handles: Quota Categories : Displays complex resource packages using CodeBuddyQuotaCategoryList src/components/codebuddy-suite/CodebuddySuiteAccountsSharedView.tsx 56 MFA Support : Includes MfaQuickCodeSelect for accounts requiring multi-factor authentication src/components/codebuddy-suite/CodebuddySuiteAccountsSharedView.tsx 41 Platform Specifics CodeBuddy (Global) : Uses planning-genie.new.accessToken for credential injection src-tauri/src/modules/codebuddy_account.rs 18 CodeBuddy CN : Uses planning-genie.new.accessTokencn and supports syncing accounts directly to Workbuddy via syncCodebuddyCnToWorkbuddy src-tauri/src/modules/codebuddy_cn_account.rs 18 src/pages/CodebuddyCnAccountsPage.tsx 61-65 Workbuddy : Manages a workbuddy-desktop.info auth file and supports OAuth via workbuddy_oauth.rs src-tauri/src/modules/workbuddy_account.rs 17 src-tauri/src/modules/workbuddy_oauth.rs 7-11 Sources: src/components/codebuddy-suite/CodebuddySuiteAccountsSharedView.tsx 41-85 src-tauri/src/modules/codebuddy_account.rs 14-18 src-tauri/src/modules/codebuddy_cn_account.rs 14-18 src-tauri/src/modules/workbuddy_account.rs 14-17 src-tauri/src/modules/workbuddy_oauth.rs 7-11 Zed Account Management Zed account management handles account persistence and synchronization with the Zed cloud service ( zed.dev ). Persistence Strategy Zed accounts are stored in a dedicated directory ( zed_accounts/ ) with a central index file ( zed_accounts.json ) src-tauri/src/modules/zed_account.rs 15-16 Index Management : load_account_index_checked ensures the index is valid and attempts to repair it from individual account files if corrupted src-tauri/src/modules/zed_account.rs 153-200 Keychain Integration : On macOS, it can interact with the system keychain to retrieve access_token and user_id src-tauri/src/modules/zed_account.rs 43-47 Entity Relationship Diagram Title: Zed Account Persistence Flow Sources: src-tauri/src/modules/zed_account.rs 12-16 src-tauri/src/modules/zed_account.rs 43-47 src-tauri/src/modules/zed_account.rs 153-200 Qoder and Trae Qoder Implementation : QoderAccountsPage.tsx manages account listing and quota display src/pages/QoderAccountsPage.tsx 45-55 Quota Tracking : Tracks included , creditPackage , and sharedCreditPackage separately via QoderQuotaDisplayItem src/pages/QoderAccountsPage.tsx 105-114 Secret Keys : Retrieves data from Qoder's internal storage using keys like secret://aicoding.auth.userInfo and secret://aicoding.auth.userPlan src-tauri/src/modules/qoder_account.rs 13-15 Trae Implementation : TraeAccountsPage.tsx supports multiple Trae variants (Trae, Trae Solo, Trae CN) src/pages/TraeAccountsPage.tsx 82-117 Quota Summary : Normalizes usage data into TraeQuotaSummary objects for UI rendering, including bonus and pay-as-you-go text src/pages/TraeAccountsPage.tsx 123-134 Persistence : Uses trae_account.rs to manage account files in the trae_accounts/ directory.
